items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: And Albert Glennie was living in the yard with my daddy... Yeah, I was a friend.

ctx.x: I was going to school. And I come up here. And Albert Glennie was living in the yard with my daddy. Just like my daddy lived in front of you. All in the back of that house, you know? Uh-huh. And he lived there. Yeah, I was a friend. I know what he was doing.
And where did he take you? Which dance hall did you say it was he took you to?
